content.user_title: Track A-Share News Attention with Lava
content.value_statement: Stock researchers need consistent measures of news attention across companies and market themes. This skill guides authenticated Lava queries and summarizes mentions, source coverage, rankings, and historical trends.
actual_capabilities: Query stock news heat and summarize mention counts, participating source counts, and structured viewpoints over a selected period.
Retrieve stock-related concepts and rank stocks within a concept by mentions.
Search structured news records by keyword and retrieve media stock-hit metadata.
Retrieve market heat rankings, source-score-weighted rankings, newly mentioned stocks, and attention acceleration rankings.
Request multiple heat windows, hourly trends, daily historical panels, and source coverage counts.
Look up current, historical, and point-in-time scores for returned agency_id values.
limitations: Requires a compatible remote HTTP MCP client, internet access, and an authenticated Lava account; data requests can incur charges.
The repository supplies instructions and service metadata, not the remote backend; service availability and data accuracy were not verified.
News-hit responses exclude article titles and bodies; historical panels cover at most 92 days and 20 targets per request.
Tools are documented as read-only and do not place trades; attention metrics do not predict returns.

use_cases.title: Review Company Attention
use_cases.description: Summarize a company over seven days using mention counts, source participation, related concepts, and returned viewpoints.

use_cases.title: Monitor Market Themes
use_cases.description: Compare concept rankings, newly mentioned stocks, and attention acceleration to prioritize daily research.

use_cases.title: Explore Historical Attention
use_cases.description: Request daily heat panels and coverage counts to study attention changes alongside other research data.

prompt_templates.title: Check One Stock
prompt_templates.prompt: Check news attention for [stock name] over seven days. Report mentions, source count, time window, and three returned viewpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Explore a Concept
prompt_templates.prompt: Rank the five most-mentioned stocks in [concept] over seven days. Report mention counts and summarize available structured viewpoints without inventing missing data.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: compare stocks within a theme

prompt_templates.title: Compare Market Signals
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare market heat and acceleration rankings over 24 hours with newly mentioned stocks. Identify overlaps and report returned attention metrics and source identifiers.

prompt_templates.title: Study Attention History
prompt_templates.prompt: For [stock], request a 90-day heat panel, 30-day coverage counts, and available point-in-time source scores. Separate observations from hypotheses and report gaps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: historical research with coverage checks

output: Illustrative format only; company labels and counts are fictional.
Window: seven days. Company A: 28 mentions. Company B: 19 mentions. Company C: 11 mentions.
Company A leads this example by mention count, not expected return.
News-hit records provide media and publication metadata, not article titles or full text.

best_practices: Configure the provider credential through the MCP client secret settings and confirm current request charges before broad queries.
Specify stock identifiers and time windows, then ground each summary in returned fields and source identifiers.
Use point-in-time scores for historical research and independently verify important claims before investment decisions.
anti_patterns: Treating mention volume or source scores as guaranteed price forecasts or trade recommendations.
Inventing source identities, article titles, full text, or statistics absent from tool results.
Submitting unlimited repeated requests after errors or ignoring insufficient-balance responses.

faq.question: What does this skill research?
faq.answer: It guides Lava queries for Chinese A-share stocks and concepts, including mentions, rankings, structured viewpoints, source scores, and historical attention.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Use a client supporting Streamable HTTP MCP, configure the documented Lava endpoint, and supply your provider credential through protected client settings.

faq.question: Are requests free?
faq.answer: The documentation describes metered data requests and a free account-balance query. Confirm current pricing and available credit with Lava.

faq.question: Does it return complete news articles?
faq.answer: No. News-hit results contain identifiers, publication times, media sources, and matched stocks, without article titles or bodies.

faq.question: Can it place trades or predict returns?
faq.answer: No trading workflow is documented. The service provides read-only attention data, which does not establish future returns.

faq.question: Was the remote service security verified?
faq.answer: No. This audit reviewed the supplied instructions and metadata, not the remote implementation, live responses, or provider data handling.
